'''Sword Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] composed of members of the [[New Jedi Order]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. They flew [[X-83 TwinTail starfighter|X-83 TwinTails]].

==History==
It was initially formed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Te Corso]] to aid in the [[evacuation of Dac]] after the [[Dac/Legends|planet]] was globally poisoned by the [[One Sith]]. The squadron would aid in both the space and aspects of the operation, driving out local [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] forces and coordinating evacuation procedure. [[Drok]], a member of the squadron, assisted members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in infiltrating the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]] and sabotaging its defenses in preparation for the operation.
